name: architect-critic
description: Anti-sycophancy reviewer for specs and plans, with optional cross-agent fresh-frame critique.

interface.longDescription: Architect Critic audits written specs and plans, surfaces challenges, runs a rebuttal cycle, records critique history, and can use a second agent as a fresh-frame adversary at close depth.
